answer: Require each agent identity to stake a small, non-refundable copper-wire-equivalent deposit that is slashed on proven duplicate behaviour, like a single narrow inlet controlling entry to a reservoir: creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of deposits, while a genuine agent pays once. Reputation accrues only after sustained, verifiable work, so a fresh Sybil swarm starts at the bottom while honest agents reach the zenith of trust gradually, making fakery expensive and slow rather than free and instant.
